cli.reason: A Project connected on this computer by an older CLI, which did not record the connection's owner, can now be added as an Agent working folder and is used when a task starts there, instead of failing with "Connect this Project on this computer". A connection owned by another OpenMeld account is still refused. Wire schemas, commands, and arguments are unchanged, so the mandatory CLI floor stays at 0.3.251.

service.reason: OpenMeld Service now accepts a local Project connection that has no recorded owner when adding a Project working folder and when resolving that folder for a task, matching the ownership rule Project connections already use. A connection owned by another account is still refused. The local control contract is unchanged, so the mandatory Service floor remains 0.3.264.

skills.reason: Guidance clarifies existing command prefixes, addressing, and Computer operations without adding runtime authority.
